sentences.text: Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pradeep Kumar Srivastava

For the Petitioners : Mr. A.K. Kashyap, Sr. Advocate For the State : Mr. Ravi Prakash, S.P.P ------
Order No.04 Dated- 21.07.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending their arrest in connection with Hussainabad P.S. Case No. 287 of 2022 instituted under Sections 406, 409, 420 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the petitioners have moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

As per FIR, allegation is that petitioner Nos.1, 2 and 3 are accountant, principal and cashier of A.K.
Singh College Japla, Palamau respectively and it is alleged that during audit it was revealed that in the period of posting of present petitioners, there was difference of Rs.1,72,356/- in the budget allocation and expenditure, and petitioners were directed to be deposited the said amount through letter issued by General Body, but they did not obey the direction.
Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that the petitioners are innocent and have committed no offence at all rather they have been falsely implicated in this case on the basis of suspicion.
Petitioners have no criminal antecedents and they are retired persons.

Petitioners have jointly prepared a demand draft of alleged defalcated amount of Rs.1,72,358/- in the name of college to deposit the same without prejudice to their defence and annexed the copy of demand draft in this petition through supplementary affidavit.
Petitioners undertake to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioners may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners and submits that there are sufficient materials against the petitioners showing their involvement in the alleged offence.
Hence, petitioners may not be extended privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioners coupled with materials available on record and also in view of fact that petitioner are ready to deposit the alleged defalcated amount of Rs.172,358/- in the bank account of college
, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender in the Court within four weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrendering,
they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty five thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned SDJM, Daltonganj in connection with Hussainabad P.S. Case No. 287 of 2022 with the condition that they will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish their mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that they will not change their mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
